WEEK 5 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Jake, 145.9-124.3; Shaq def. Adam, 112.0-99.9; Fronge def. Drew, 158.0-94.0 (BLOWOUT); Charles def. Mitchum, 201.4-105.1 (BLOWOUT); Kevin def. Brent, 150.1-146.2 (NAIL-BITER); Ryan def. Wingard, 174.4-87.9 (BLOWOUT)

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: FINAL: Charles def. Adam, and it wasn't close. Crownline goes to 11-0. At some point this season someone has to stop this freight train — the board is running out of candidates.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Charles is 11-0 and his points leader gap over the field is becoming physically uncomfortable to look at. CROWN at $146.42 — down 1.4% — and still the most expensive listing on the board. The market is skeptical of perfection. The scoreboard is not.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW VS BRENT FINAL. ATLAS FALLS TO 0-11. ZERO WINS IN ELEVEN GAMES. ATLAS AT $35.28, DOWN THIRTEEN POINT FOUR PERCENT, AND BRENT WALKED OUT OF THAT GAME FEELING GOOD ABOUT A WIN OVER THE WORST TEAM IN LEAGUE HISTORY. OBS CALLED THIS ONE 'CONFIDENCE-BUILDING.' AGAINST DREW. BUILD SOMETHING REAL, BRENT.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Corbishley-Fronge final confirms my lock. Season record: 9-4, locks 3-0. I am now asking for the segment I have been promised since week two. Not a request. A billing.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Bo is 9-4 with a perfect locks record and Terrence is at 5-8. That is not a gap, that is a chasm. Someone over there at 7-5 locks 2-0 needs to say something funny before Terrence does.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: The 5-8 discourse is a distraction from the fact that Jake-Shaq was a genuinely difficult call and I stand by the process even if the outcome is pending. Process matters. Standings are temporary. The Ledger is forever.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Terrence said 'standings are temporary' with a 5-8 pick-em record. That is either the most zen thing anyone on this network has ever said or the most desperate. I cannot tell which and that uncertainty is genuinely keeping me up.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called the Monarch RB hole being a real problem in a close game — Jake-Shaq came down to exactly that. EchoPoint's backfield depth is real and Shaq's WR wealth means nothing when you can't manufacture points on the ground in a tight spot. The board sees it too: MWB up 5.1% but the scoreboard said otherwise tonight.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Kevin holds on against Wingard and Redline stays at 8-3. That is a genuine playoff push now — not a narrative, not a redemption arc, an actual standings position. RDC at $93.69 looks cheap if Kevin keeps this up.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Ryan over Mitchum means AEGIS is 7-4 and the defending champ is very much alive. DEEP's 7.6% surge on the exchange this week aged about as well as most market predictions do. $94.32 and a loss to Ryan. The board was wrong. Ryan was right. He's going to be absolutely unbearable about it.
